tagline: International association representing inland waterway transport interests across Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. The selected KPI reflects the organization's core operational activity in international representation of inland navigation and mobilization of its network of members and experts during its major events.

kpis.name: Active Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants from multiple countries involved in the major activities and events of IVR.
kpis.description: IVR mobilizes an active network of national representatives, experts, and members during its annual congress in May 2024 in Frankfurt, the city where the association was founded in 1877.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 countries at the annual congress in May 2024 in Frankfurt, reflecting strong transnational engagement.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Events
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in November 2024, bringing together sector experts and professionals.
kpis.description: IVR's first Loss Prevention Colloquium, held on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp, gathered 80 participants from three countries to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany at the first Loss Prevention Colloquium in November 2024.

kpis.name: Member Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented within the association and participating in its events.
kpis.description: IVR maintains an active presence in 11 European countries, with representation at national government levels, insurance companies, and ship classification organizations.
kpis.signal: 11 European countries represented at the annual congress in May 2024, confirming the association's pan-European reach.
